name: Top Trumps
summary: Themed card battle game where players compare stats on cards to capture opponents' cards and win the whole deck.
rules_text: All cards are shuffled and dealt as evenly as possible into face-down stacks. Each player may see only the top card of their own stack. On a turn, the current chooser picks one attribute from their top card and all players reveal its value. The highest value wins the round, taking all revealed top cards and placing them under their stack. Ties or any 'no data' for the chosen attribute cause all top cards to go to a middle pile; the same chooser picks again from their next card, and the next winner also takes the middle pile. When a player runs out of cards they are out. Play continues sequentially until one player holds all cards and wins.
rating_reason: Specific attribute comparison game, fits engine
